scripts.setup: rustup target add wasm32-unknown-unknown && cargo install wasm-pack --version 0.14.0 --locked && cargo install tauri-cli --version 2.11.1 --locked && bun install --cwd frontend --frozen-lockfile
scripts.check:fast: bun run fmt:check && bun run clippy && bun run test && bun run check:wasm && bun run --cwd frontend test && bun run --cwd frontend check && bun run --cwd frontend build
scripts.check:ci: bun run check:fast && bun run --cwd frontend e2e && bun run check:desktop
scripts.package:linux: bun run tauri -- build --bundles deb && node scripts/create-linux-portable.mjs
